title: An armored commander is reprimanded for bowing
translation: As the royal procession passed the troops left in position, their commander prostrated himself to receive it. The king instructed: “I have already given an order concerning the principle that a man in armor and helmet does not bow. A military formation differs from the ranks assembled at court. The commander of the Royal Guards’ formation has failed to observe the proper conduct. Investigate the commander concerned, Yi Han-eung.”

notes.title: Investigate, not a stated punishment
notes.text: 推考 orders an investigation into an official’s conduct. This entry does not state its outcome or a final penalty.
